name: preview__FluidSearch

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Specify an optional value for the `autocomplete` property on the underlying `<input>`, defaults to "off"

props.name: closeButtonLabelText
props.description: Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the "close" button

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optionally provide the default value of the `<input>`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `<input>` should be disabled

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the label text for the Search icon

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Provide an optional placeholder text for the Search. Note: if the label and placeholder differ, VoiceOver on Mac will read both

props.name: type
props.description: Optional prop to specify the type of the `<input>`

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon preview__FluidSearch rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
